detail: Selected Constraints for non-promoting source review after structural DAG validation; Body remains a deferred proof dependency.

Independent audits found unresolved imports, duplicate mutable ownership, nominal type schemas, missing registry commands and revisions, weak snapshot validation, missing Body reference checks, and separate break state.
Replaced nominal candidate schemas and duplicate state with ten stateless type normalizers, one pure break evaluator, and one strict exact-once Registry owner.
Body-detachment enforcement and provider synchronization remain explicit later-package gates; generated outputs and behavior proof remain deferred until source freeze.
Syntax, module resolution, factory uniqueness, manifest/source parity, public path uniqueness, capability union, dependency providers, boundary searches, and diff whitespace passed.
